messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — canary A/B rollout of the new kernel-selection heuristic is showing a regression on p95 for long-context requests :rotating_light:. Seeing this in the canary group only, started ~10:10 UTC.
Maya: Ugh, which metric jumped? p50/p95/tokens/sec?
Jordan: p50 ~ stable, p95 from ~210ms -> ~620ms for 2k token sequences. Throughput down ~35% on those shards. Observed increase in KVCACHE miss rate too.
Arjun: @Jordan can you paste the CI perf output? Also, which commit did we merge onto main before the rollout?
Jordan: CI snippet:
```
TEST: long-context-e2e
baseline p95: 210ms
current p95: 620ms (+195%)
tokens/sec baseline: 9.4
tokens/sec current: 6.1 (-35%)
KV hit-rate baseline: 82%
KV hit-rate current: 58%
CI job: runtime/perf/long-context #4321
```
Jordan: Merge was 0a1b2c3 -> kernel auto-select + batch heuristic tweak.
Liam: :eyes: probably kernel-choice fallback is selecting the quantized path even for long seqs. I remember a guard in the selector that had reversed inequality in last PR.
Sophia: Could be the comparator in kernel_score() — accidentally lowered score for aten-optimized kernels on >1k seqs.
Maya: Can we bisect quickly? I can run `git bisect` against the perf harness in a separate branch. Prefer not to touch canary traffic until we confirm.
Arjun: Start bisect and run perf-runner; if you get a suspect commit, post the diff here. Use `--no-cache` for the harness to avoid warm KV state masking the issue.
Jordan: Kicked off bisect:
```
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
git bisect bad 0a1b2c3
git bisect good f9e8d7c
git bisect run ./ci/perf/run_long_context.sh --no-cache
```
Jordan: Bisect found commit 4f7e9bd "kernel: prefer fusion kernel when batch_size>8" as first bad.
Liam: That seems plausible — fusion kernel had an unexpected path that drops prefetching for KV cache. I can review.
Sophia: For canary safety, can we pause rollout and fallback to previous kernel selector? deploy-bot, can we pause the canary group?
deploy-bot: Received command to pause rollout. Canary group paused at 20% traffic. Action: PAUSE_ROLLOUT by @Sophia.
Maya: Good. Also proposing an automatic SLO gate: if p95 exceeds baseline*2 or KV hit-rate drops >15% for >5m, auto-rollback the canary. Thoughts?
Arjun: +1 for automation but we need to avoid noisy rollbacks. Suggest two-step: immediate pause + amber alert to oncall; auto-rollback only after 3 consecutive 1m windows failing.
Sophia: Agree. We should also add a lightweight probe that hits specifically long-context path (2k tokens) to avoid masking by short-context traffic.
Jordan: I'll add the probe to observability and wire it into the rollout guard. Proposed config snippet for rollout guard:
```
rollout.guard:
  probe: /metrics/probe/long-context
  window_m: 1
  fail_threshold: 2  # number of consecutive windows
  p95_ratio_threshold: 2.0
  kv_hit_drop_pct: 15
  action_on_fail: pause_then_rollback
```
Liam: For implementation, runtime-router can emit the probe and rollout-controller can subscribe. We also need to ensure the probe warms KV in the canary path before measuring — maybe run short warmup then measure.
Jordan: Good call. We'll run a 30s warmup in probe, then 60s measurement windows.
Maya: After rollback/pausing, please open a short RFC for making the kernel selector tests part of CI perf gating. We missed this because unit tests weren't catching performance delta.
Arjun: I'll add a CI job that runs long-context perf once per PR on the runtime repo — maybe keep it optional for forks but required for mainline merges touching kernel_selector.
srebot: CI Perf Job runtime/perf/long-context #4321 status: FLAKY -> INVESTIGATING. Alert sent to oncall.
Sophia: Next steps: 1) keep canary paused 2) Liam to audit kernel fusion change and propose patch 3) Jordan to add probe + observability 4) Maya to run extended bisect + confirm fix locally 5) Arjun to draft CI gating job. Assign owners?
Jordan: I'll own probe + rollout config. Liam owns kernel patch. Maya owns bisect verification. Arjun owns CI gating RFC. Sophia will oversee canary ops.
Liam: Starting code review for 4f7e9bd now. If it's obviously dropping prefetch, I'll push a revert/patch and ask deploy of a hotfix canary.
Jordan: Thanks all. Will post bisect logs and a minimal reproducer shortly. For visibility: link to perf job https://ci.redwood.ai/job/runtime/perf/4321
Maya: :thumbsup: keep the updates in this thread and ping oncall if we need immediate rollback.
Jordan: Last: bisect log pasted to artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/bisect/1809993123/4f7e9bd.log
